$description: COMPONENT tokens for the text-field family. Height is here for the same reason Button's is: it carries the touch floor, and deriving it from the spacing scale would let a spacing change shrink a control below the minimum. The value deliberately equals button.height.md so a field and a button line up in a row; if a shared control-height role ever appears, both should move to it together.

md.$description: 44px. Matches the default button so a field and a button align on one line.

default.$description: Horizontal padding inside a text control. Tighter than a button's, because text starts at the edge of the box rather than being centred in it.
88px, two field heights. A textarea that starts one line tall reads as a broken input.
